lines.text: *Cough* These KPIs... aren't bad.
Transaction complete.
Money makes the world go 'round, dear client.
One day, when I'm at the top of the corporate ladder, you can be my special guest.
We got our quarterly sales report, but that only figures in sales that are above board, so it's just the tip of the iceberg.
Wanna hit the bars after work? I'll book us a table.
Time is more valuable than money. Never waste time hesitating about anything.
So go for a drive together to clear your mind? I just finished tuning my sports car.
Did you know there are spaces in the Outpost Mall exclusively for VIP members? How do I know this, you ask? I am the manager.
No one is ever completely innocent.
How about swinging by the mall when you're free? I'm sure you'll find something that piques your interest.
Looking for a good time? Look no further.
One step closer to the top.
I can start a bigger business.
Investments will pay off.
You really don't expect anything in return? Thank you.
It's a wise investment.
Surely you must have some kind of motive in giving me this.
It seems we have more in common than I expected.

If it's with you, then I'm willing to give it a shot...
... What? I was referring to our business dealings.

I don't mind being someone a bit forward.
So... how about we go on a cruise this weekend?
It should be crystal clear who gets what.
I'm listening.
Toward the target point.
Encounter.
Let me handle this.
Oh, how sweet it would be to have a capable commander.
Perfect, I can try out this new product.
Cover me.
Wait till I get my reloading done.
Snipers incoming!
I'm ready.
Hindrance to business detected. Removing now.
Playtime's over, let's finish this!
Nice.
Processing finished.
We're on a roll! Let's keep it going!
Urgh!
Ow!
Damn...
Preliminary research insufficient.
With high risk comes high reward. Isn't that why we fight?
